# J-ROCK Bitunix Futures API Client

> AI agent documentation for integrating the Bitunix USDT-M futures REST API into a Node.js trading engine. Provides endpoint methods, signing mechanism, error handling, and position management. Version: v1.0.0 | Last updated: 2026-10-21

## Getting Started

- [Install dependencies](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/docs/api-demo.md): npm install dotenv pg ws
- [Initialize BitunixClient](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/src/bitunix/client.js): api-key setup, signature generation
- [API endpoint catalog](url:docs/api-demo.md): all 38 REST endpoints with method signatures

## Reference

- [API Demo Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/docs/api-demo.md): Runnable tour with --list and --dry-run modes
- [API Parity Table](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/docs/api-parity.md): Java SDK → Node.js mapping with discrepancies
- [BitunixClient source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/src/bitunix/client.js): main client implementation
- [Position Manager](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/src/trader/position-manager.js): leverage, TP/SL, protection logic
- [Test Suite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qezawat-a/bitunix-agent-cline/main/tests/): integration tests for all endpoints

## Optional

- [Error Codes Reference](src/bitunix/client.js#L150): Error code to human-readable mapping
- [Trading Strategy Implementation](src/trader/trader.js): How position sizing uses API data
- [WebSocket Client](src/bitunix/ws.js): Real-time market data channels
